SELECT
    o.oid,
    o.ndet,
    o.firstmjd,
    o.lastmjd,
    p.probability,
    ss.candid,
    ss.ssdistnr,
    ss.ssnamenr
FROM object o
WHERE o.ndet > 500
  AND o.oid IN (
      /* Get OIDs classified as asteroid with probability > 0.5 by stamp_classifier version stamp_classifier_1.0.4 */
      SELECT oid
      FROM probability
      WHERE class_name = 'asteroid'
        AND classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
        AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
        AND probability > 0.5
  )
  AND o.oid IN (
      /* Get OIDs with distance to nearest known solar system object < 2 arcsec */
      SELECT oid
      FROM ss_ztf
      WHERE ssdistnr < 2
  )
ORDER BY o.firstmjd
LIMIT 10
